title: Fix N+1 in BlockDetailsScreen._loadMembers
objective: Replace the sequential for-loop of awaits in BlockDetailsScreen._loadMembers with a single concurrent fetch — either Future.wait over a list of getByIdAsync calls or, preferably, a backend-side expand=member parameter that returns each CarnivalBlockMembersEntity with its MembersEntity embedded.
description: BlockDetailsScreen._loadMembers (lib/ui/carnivalBlock/blockDetails/widgets/block_details_screen.dart, lines 81-122) currently fires one HTTP GET per member in a sequential for-loop. For a block with 50 members this is 50 round-trips; for a block with 200 members it is 200. The fix has two acceptable shapes: (1) minimal-change: collect member IDs into a list and await Future.wait over membersRepo.getByIdAsync(id), keeping the rest of the method identical; (2) preferred: add an expand=member query parameter to the CarnivalBlockMembers API so the backend returns each membership with the nested MembersEntity and the screen consumes a List<CarnivalBlockMembersWithMember>. The fix preserves the public signature of _loadMembers, the _MemberTile widget contract, and the _membersError / _loadingMembers state lifecycle. Do NOT touch the meetings fetch in _loadMeetings (lines 124-145) — it has its own N+1 but that is out of scope for this subtask.

anchors: lines 89-91 — repo.getByBlockIdAsync(...) (KEEP — this is the first request)
lines 93-108 — the sequential for-loop over members that awaits membersRepo.getByIdAsync(member.memberId) per member (REWRITE — see fix below)
lines 109-115 — if (mounted) setState(...) success branch (KEEP — only invoked after the concurrent fetch completes)

reference_files.reason: Source for the existing getByBlockIdAsync method. If the preferred fix shape (expand=member) is chosen, add a new method signature here; otherwise this file is read-only for context.
If the preferred fix is chosen, define CarnivalBlockMembersWithMember entity here as a freezed union or a wrapper.

fix_shapes.minimal_change: Inside the (members) async branch of _loadMembers: replace the for-loop with final entityFutures = members.map((m) => membersRepo.getByIdAsync(m.memberId)); final results = await Future.wait(entityFutures); then build the same Map<int, MembersEntity> by iterating results. Falls back to the placeholder MembersEntity on a per-id failure exactly like today.
fix_shapes.preferred: Add getByBlockIdWithMembersAsync(int blockId) to ICarnivalBlockMembersApiClient + ICarnivalBlockMembersRepository. The new endpoint accepts ?expand=member and returns List<CarnivalBlockMembersWithMember>. Define CarnivalBlockMembersWithMember in lib/domain/entities/carnivalBlockMembers/ as a freezed class with members: CarnivalBlockMembersEntity, member: MembersEntity. _loadMembers calls the new endpoint and the _memberEntities map is built in a single synchronous pass.

acceptance_criteria: _loadMembers no longer contains a for-loop whose body awaits membersRepo.getByIdAsync(...) sequentially
All HTTP GETs needed to render the members list are dispatched concurrently (Future.wait) or, if the preferred shape is chosen, are replaced by a single GET to the new endpoint

_memberEntities map is populated for every member.id present in the response, falling back to a placeholder MembersEntity (id + name='Membro' + email=null + profileImage=null) only when the per-id fetch (or the per-record field) is missing
if (mounted) gate is preserved around the success-branch setState
Pull-to-refresh on the screen still triggers both _loadMembers and _loadMeetings

If the preferred shape is chosen: CarnivalBlockMembersWithMember is defined with @freezed annotation, has a matching .freezed.dart + .g.dart file, and the existing CarnivalBlockMembersEntity is unchanged
flutter analyze lib/ui/carnivalBlock/blockDetails/ returns no errors

grep_evidence: rg -n 'for \(final member in members\)' lib/ui/carnivalBlock/blockDetails/widgets/block_details_screen.dart must return zero matches inside _loadMembers (lines 81-122)
rg -n 'Future\.wait|getByBlockIdWithMembersAsync' lib/ui/carnivalBlock/blockDetails/ must return at least one match
validation.scope_check: Lines 124-145 (_loadMeetings) must be unchanged — its N+1 is a separate concern.

no_op_outside_scope: Do not modify _loadMeetings, _MembersSection, _MemberTile, _MemberGroup, the public BlockDetailsScreen constructor, or any file outside lib/ui/carnivalBlock/blockDetails/. If the preferred shape is chosen, the new entity file is added to lib/domain/entities/carnivalBlockMembers/ — that is the one allowed external file write.
